name: Montana
overview: Montana combines a refundable elderly homeowner/renter credit with separate property-tax assistance and a time-limited homeowner rebate.

programs.name: Elderly Homeowner/Renter Credit
programs.incomeDefinition: Gross income of all household members, including specified nontaxable sources; a $12,600 exclusion and income multipliers enter the formula.
programs.formulaSummary: Qualifying billed property taxes plus 15% of rent, less calculated household-income contribution; cap preliminary credit, then apply the gross-income multiplier.
programs.application: Schedule 2EC with Form 2, including when filing only for the refundable credit.
eligibilityNotes: Montana residence at least nine months and qualifying occupancy at least six months.
Only one household member may claim.

programs.name: 2025 Property Tax Rebate for Homeowners
programs.maximumBenefit: Up to $400 for the 2025 application program.
programs.formulaSummary: One-time rebate limited by qualifying tax and the program cap. Its exact tax-payment reference year is not established in this record.
eligibilityNotes: Owned and occupied principal residence for at least seven months in 2024.
programs.programYear: Payment/application program in 2025 with 2024 occupancy; not a recurring 2025 income-tax credit.

programs.name: Property Tax Assistance Program (PTAP)
programs.incomeDefinition: Prior reference-year federal AGI under the 2025 application rules.
programs.incomeLimits: July 2025 legislative summary lists maximum 2023 FAGI of $28,329 single or $37,968 married/head of household.
programs.maximumBenefit: Reduce taxable value on up to $350,000 of market value to 20%, 50%, or 70%, depending on income.
programs.formulaSummary: Income-tiered reduction of taxable homestead value rather than a refundable renter credit.
programs.application: Apply to Montana DOR under the applicable PTAP-year process.
eligibilityNotes: Ownership and occupancy for at least seven months of the year.
interactions: Separate from the Elderly Homeowner/Renter Credit and one-time homeowner rebate.
programs.programYear: 2025 program description using 2023 federal AGI; later application schedules use separate income-reference years.

sources.title: Montana Legislature property-tax overview, July 2025, page 8

laterChanges: The post-2025 homestead and long-term-rental rate rules are not established in this 2025 description.
researchNotes: The agency overview labels the rebate as 2025 and uses 2024 occupancy. Its exact tax-payment reference year remains unverified.
PTAP and disabled-veteran rate reductions follow separate rules from refundable income-tax credits.
